source.title: La Sanch, processions des pénitents du Vendredi saint en Roussillon (Pyrénées-Orientales)
source.authority: French Ministry of Culture, Inventaire national du patrimoine culturel immatériel
source.edition: 2023 inventory, modern administrative synthesis including original historical references
source.verification: Direct PDF source review using web PDF extracted text and page screenshot of printed page 5; references are web line and 1-based printed-page numbers as PDF displayed, not original primary-event archival source folios

classification_principle: Source action and material/period/locality variants remain components of the La Sanch penitential-procession complex. Where inventory refers to events 1416-1959, those are secondary inventory historical assertions, not directly inspected original archival documents. French cultural heritage documentation is not a source of 1962 Roman liturgical approval. Old Holy Thursday date and newer Good Friday date may not be collapsed; biblical representation and folk customs not confused with Missal rubrics.
